title: Estate Services Note: Base Carried by a Replacement Capital Credit Check by Account Status
content:
# Base Carried by a Replacement Check, by Account Status

**Estate services note — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** A replacement check carries a base that depends on the account it is issued from:

- on an account in **estate claim pending** status it carries the whole retired amount owed on the account;
- on an **inactive** account it carries the voided amount together with the rest of the amount owed where that rest is below the class's smallest check payout, and the voided amount alone otherwise;
- on an account in any other status nothing is added to the voided amount.

## Definitions

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Voided amount | the amount of the most recent void entry on the account |
| Amount owed | the account's retired credits owed at the time of the replacement, which already include the voided amount the void returned |
| Rest of the amount owed | the amount owed less the voided amount |
| Smallest check payout | $10.00 in the Residential, Seasonal, Farm, General Service and Irrigation Patron Classes; $25.00 in the Large Power Patron Class |

## Cases (hypothetical, Farm Patron Class unless stated)

| Account status | Amount owed | Voided amount | Rest | Base carried |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| estate claim pending | $812.30 | $96.00 | $716.30 | $812.30 |
| inactive | $57.40 | $50.00 | $7.40 (below $10.00) | $57.40 |
| inactive | $60.00 | $50.00 | $10.00 (not below $10.00) | $50.00 |
| inactive | $75.00 | $50.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| inactive, Large Power Patron Class | $74.00 | $50.00 | $24.00 (below $25.00) | $74.00 |
| active | $57.40 | $50.00 | $7.40 | $50.00 |
